author: Forbes
description:
How do you go from getting bribed with quarters to play golf at two years old to hitting 300 million views a month, beating Steph Curry in a 1v1 match, and outperforming the PGA Tour on social media?

Welcome to the Forbes Top Creator Show! This week, host Steven Bertoni takes the show out of the studio and onto the fairway at Liberty National Golf Course in Jersey City to chat with creator, athlete, and entrepreneur Gabby DeGasperis (Gabby Golf Girl).

Gabby breaks down her incredible origin story, starting when her mom created the @gabbygolfgirl account when Gabby was just six years old to showcase her trick shots. She opens up about being bullied in eighth grade, taking a six-month bet to post every single day, and dropping out of traditional school at age 14 the moment her newest video generated three million views overnight.

Gabby delivers a masterclass on sports content creation, detailing how she overcame closed doors as a young female outlier in a male-dominated sport by adop
title: How Gabby Golf Girl Gets 300+ Million Views A Month
